description.zh: 修改后的VBR限速带宽，单位：Mbps。
description.en: The new bandwidth limit of the VBR. Unit: Mbit/s.

description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** of each API request is different.

description.zh:

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the VBR. 

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query region IDs.
The instance ID of the VBR.

title.en: Modify bandwidth throttling on a VBR
